notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's lib.rs is crate plumbing: module re-exports, AUTH_PORT/CLIENT_BUILD constants, host:port splitting, and the logon() orchestration (challenge -> SRP6 -> proof -> realm list). MSUI realizes the same flow through RealmClient.Logon with the same constants (build 5875, port from config); no independent wire contract beyond what protocol/auth already covers.
